items.text: An MBA in agribusiness career path leads to roles in agricultural inputs, food supply chains, rural marketing, commodity and procurement, agri-finance and farmer-facing programmes, and it works best for people who understand farm economics, seasonal cycles and rural markets.
Choose a function, learn how one value chain works end to end and build a short analysis of its costs and risks.
